 Match Preview
 AFC Champions League Elite - Game Week 4 3 Nov 2026 - 11:00 Esteghlal and Al-Shamal meet in the AFC Champions League Elite group stage, with both clubs looking to build momentum in the West region standings.
 Esteghlal head into this fixture under coach Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh having shown mixed form across competitions. The Iranian side have been competitive in continental play but have struggled for consistency in the Persian Gulf Pro League.
 Al-Shamal arrive having suffered a heavy 4-1 defeat to Al-Sadd in the Stars League on October 30, their most recent outing before this fixture. Coach David Prats will be looking for a response after that setback.
 The Qatari side did beat Al Hilal 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite on October 27, which shows they can compete at this level despite their inconsistency in domestic competition.
 Esteghlal sit sixth in the West group table, while Al-Shamal are eighth, making this a contest with real implications for both sides' hopes of advancing.
